description: Ajust is an Australian consumer advocacy service that helps people resolve complaints and disputes with businesses. Its service provides AI-assisted complaint handling, escalation guidance, and case intake for consumer issues.
summary: Ajust exposes one OAuth-protected partner REST API at `api.ajust.com.au` plus two public streamable-HTTP MCP endpoints on `agent.ajust.com.au` (Claude and ChatGPT connectors).
